title: anisotome aromatica var. incisa
intro: Anisotome aromatica var. incisa, commonly known as New Zealand aniseed myrtle, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The essential oil extracted from Anisotome aromatica var. incisa contains compounds like limonene, beta-pinene, and beta-myrcene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
